sources.mechanic: Observation restrains an otherwise changeable object.
A rider moves with an unobserved carrier; removing observation enables transport.
Which geometry is observed affects traversability.

transformation: Original two-dimensional lantern transit: an optical focus pins a moving shutter or courier; one observed photograph temporarily pins its pictured object. All other objects continue evolving, and couriers must pass physically open apertures. Continuous transit replaces source teleportation; image fading is a new visible resource. No source artwork, characters, layouts, code, music or copied presentation is shipped. The crosscurrent revision adds smooth independent vertical courier drift, frozen by the same light/photo rule. Both courier coordinates and the moving aperture participate in collision and replay; lane-center parking no longer implies a safe passage. The subsequent observation revision uses a common one-second arrow scale and visible swing guides in both modes. A seed-free recent-window forecast controller is an implementation diagnostic, not an optimal-policy or native API certificate. The visible-current revision retains the same difficulty profiles, restraint and collision rules. It replaces hidden rate seeds with visible current angular/forward rates and their rising/falling directions, bounded reflecting rates, readable motion dials, and quantized phase and coordinates. There is no unobserved future rate process. This addresses bounded-window observability; optimal-action witnesses and native solutions still require validation.
assets: Original Canvas geometry and CSS; no third-party artwork. The preserved v3 rate bank is a historical task-owned asset and is not consumed by visible-current-v4.
validation_status: implementation_checks_in_progress; native API, formal grouped-mode real-time classification and human calibration unverified; independent re-audit revision requested
